Sample slurm.conf

This page provides a sample slurm.conf with inline comments explaining each parameter. Omnia auto-generates a slurm.conf if none is provided; use this reference to create a custom configuration when needed.

Complete sample

File: /etc/slurm/slurm.conf

Key parameter reference

Parameter

Description

ClusterName

Unique identifier for the Slurm cluster. Used in job accounting.

SlurmctldHost

Hostname of the controller node; must be resolvable by all nodes.

SchedulerType

sched/backfill is recommended for production; fills gaps with smaller jobs.

SelectType

select/cons_tres enables fine-grained tracking of CPUs, memory, and GPUs.

GresTypes

Comma-separated list of generic resource types (e.g., gpu).

PartitionName

Defines a job queue with a set of nodes, time limit, and state.

NodeName

Declares a node or node range with hardware specifications.

Note

  • Adjust CPUs, RealMemory, Sockets, CoresPerSocket, and Gres to match your actual hardware. Mismatched values cause nodes to register as DRAIN.

  • Node names must match the hostnames in the PXE mapping file.

Note

  • Slurmdbd Conf – Companion slurmdbd.conf configuration.

  • Omnia Config – Omnia-level Slurm settings.
